name: Techlead Npn Public Company Limited
summary: Techlead Next Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides technology solutions in Thailand. The company operates in two segments, Agriculture and Information Technology. It offers PromptPay, a payment gateway solution; digital marketing and communication services; and a marketplace platform that facilitates transactions and manages after-sales systems digitally. The company also develops custom campaigns and specialized software for various industries. In addition, it engages in the plantation, extraction, processing, distribution, import, export, and agriculture of hemps, and marijuana. The company was formerly known as Techlead NPN Public Company Limited and changed its name to Techlead Next Public Company Limited in February 2026. Techlead Next Public Company Limited was incorporated in 1987 and is based in Bangkok, Thailand.
